title: GAX-P02 - Matched baseline harness and evidence-packet contract
outcome: Create a model-agnostic baseline harness that runs typed-decision adapters under one failure, metric, timing, and provenance contract before GAX model training begins.
rationale: The paper requires fair matched comparisons. Without a shared adapter and evidence-packet layer, each baseline can silently differ in candidate actions, denominators, calibration, truncation, timing, or failure handling. P02 freezes those comparison semantics before GAX v0.
scope_in: Typed adapter protocol and immutable adapter identity
Prediction-file adapter for externally produced typed outputs
Per-item success/failure accounting with no silent drops
Evidence-packet manifests binding revisions, commands, datasets, hardware metadata, predictions, metrics, failures, and timings
External baseline registry with explicit availability and qualification state
Linux/Windows CI for the offline harness
scope_out: No GAX model implementation or training
No clinical or benchmark superiority claim
No automatic substitution of unavailable baseline implementations
acceptance: Adapter protocol exposes immutable identity, deterministic-mode declaration, exact item-to-prediction mapping, and typed probabilities
Runner records every requested item as success or failure and never evaluates an incomplete prediction set as though complete
Uniform and lexicographic deterministic controls produce reproducible typed predictions without model downloads
Prediction-file adapter verifies item IDs, action keys, probability distributions, and immutable file digest

Evidence packet records repository revision, adapter identity, benchmark file digests, command/config, seed, calibration revision, runtime metadata, counts, raw predictions where allowed, failures, timings, and P01 metrics
Packet metrics are generated only when every requested labeled item completed successfully
Timing data distinguishes adapter execution from evaluation/serialization and does not claim cross-hardware superiority
External baseline registry records CLM, Laya, decider, restricted-logit, structured-output LLM, clinical encoder, and Jev access/qualification states without invented results
CLI can run the deterministic offline suite end to end and write a reproducible evidence packet
Unit tests cover malformed predictions, duplicate/missing outputs, adapter failures, prediction-file mutation, deterministic controls, packet hashing, and CLI execution
Exact-head CI runs Ruff, mypy strict, pytest, and compileall on Python 3.11/3.12 across Linux and Windows
P02 introduces no GAX training, clinical dataset, PHI, or performance claim

risk.recovery: Revert P02 files and return to canonical P01 at d9b27c8d302bd5af498b7a1b1ccdbac04f0e28c7. No GAX weights, model training, or clinical datasets are affected.

minimality.rationale: The minimum defensible P02 is a deterministic adapter protocol, failure-safe runner, evidence-packet writer, baseline registry, and offline controls before any network/model-specific baseline is trusted.

requirements: No clinical dataset or PHI enters P02.
Failed inference must remain visible and must block complete-run metrics.
External baseline availability must be stated explicitly instead of inferring or fabricating results.
Timing claims require matched hardware and protocol.

unresolved_decisions: Exact external model revisions are frozen only when each upstream baseline is qualified.
Jev remains optional if reproducible evaluation access or terms do not permit matched measurement.
The final structured-output LLM baseline is selected at experiment freeze.

qualification: Linux Python 3.11 Ruff, mypy strict, pytest, and compileall passed
Linux Python 3.12 Ruff, mypy strict, pytest, and compileall passed
Windows Python 3.11 Ruff, mypy strict, pytest, and compileall passed
Windows Python 3.12 Ruff, mypy strict, pytest, and compileall passed
Offline controls, failure accounting, registry validation, CLI execution, and evidence packets are covered by tests
No GAX model training, clinical dataset ingestion, PHI, or external-model performance claim was introduced
closeout.note: This proves the P02 core harness grain only. P02 remains active until external baseline adapter tasks are qualified.
